title: ID0412858-DC/SI-D/FR -[MP/R4 170001711]-DOOR ISSUE-C1
description:

additional_info.subject: 0412858 - ID0412858-DC/SI-D/FR -[MP/R4 170001711]-DOOR ISSUE-C1 CRM:00472000281
additional_info.body:
Hello Franck,
I receive this ticket and is mentioned that you observed the issue. I would need someone to inspect the locking mechanism. Would you be available or have some technician on site that I could guide?
The mechanism is located near the door button, but you will need to access it from the back of the charger. Space is limited in this area, so the inspection may be a bit complicated.
Check if all parts are not broken and if there is no wire out of the correct place.
In attachment there are some pictures with the mechanism.
I will be available to guide you during inspection, let me know what else you need from my side to support.
With best regards,
Joao Francisco Louro Cardoso
